note: Election of the Down County Council, polled 1 June 1967 (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, 'Round Up of the County Councils'). The returning officer's 'Notice of result of elections, 1967' (Belfast Newsletter, 6 June 1967, p. 8) names the member elected for all twenty divisions: eighteen were returned unopposed and Kilkeel and Newry were polled. Returned unopposed.
